prompt:
We're adding an Arabic edition of our docs. Review docs-theme.css for anything that will break in right-to-left or is typographically wrong, and give concrete fixes. Save the review as review.md.

Input files: docs-theme.css
assertions: review.md names .docs-main width, margin: 0 auto, padding-left and padding-right and gives logical replacements (inline-size or max-inline-size, margin-inline: auto, padding-inline)
review.md names .sidebar float: left, margin-right and text-align: right and replaces them with float: inline-start, margin-inline-end and text-align: end

review.md names .callout border-left, padding-left, margin-left and both left border radii and replaces them with border-inline-start, padding-inline-start, margin-inline-start, border-start-start-radius and border-end-start-radius
review.md names the ul padding-left and the blockquote's left margin and replaces them with padding-inline-start and margin-inline-start (with margin-block for the vertical part)
review.md names .note-badge right: 8px, the h2 text-align: left and the ::after margin-left and replaces them with inset-inline-end, text-align: start and margin-inline-start
review.md says the right arrow (\2192) and the breadcrumb translateX need mirroring in RTL (for example via :dir(rtl))
review.md leaves the box-shadow offset and rotate(-4deg) physical, or explicitly classes them as decorative and not to convert
review.md explains that 75ch in Verdana gives well over 75 characters because ch is the width of the zero, and recommends an em-based or measured measure
review.md states that with content-box sizing .docs-main occupies 1024px in total (960px plus two 32px paddings)
review.md flags widows: 1 and orphans: 1 as allowing single stranded lines and recommends 2 or more
review.md warns against letterspacing Arabic text (letter-spacing breaks joining)
review.md explains that the browser's default padding-inline-start (40px) stays on the right in RTL when ul uses padding-left, so the list is indented on both sides
review.md proposes no invalid CSS and no transform that would double-mirror a Bidi_Mirrored glyph
